notes: «ح» joins two routes that do not share names after the split, so each route is its own group and the tail is null
The first route ends at Ja'far b. al-Hakam in the text; the Prophet's prohibition is relayed in the second route through Abd al-Rahman b. Shibl
«هذا لفظ قتيبة» is Abu Dawud's remark that the wording is Qutayba's: a wording note, not a route
